tp4-dflash.qualification: Qualified through 64 sequences with its speculative accuracy gate waived by a maintainer decision (2026-10-06). The C64 pooled speculative logprob gate failed four times (single draws +0.0085, +0.0082 and +0.0076 nats; the mean of four draws +0.0057, CI95 [0.0003, 0.0162], against the 0.005-nat margin), while the paired and absolute teacher gates and every draw's top-1 bound passed. The waiver rests on sampling-level evidence: at temperature 1.0 and top-p 0.95, DFlash draws differ from AR C32 by a mean total variation of 0.0064-0.0072, as AR's own B8, B16 and B64 draws do (0.0065-0.0071), and 71% of the logprob excess sits on tokens below 0.7% probability. MIMO-REQUAL batch 409cd7348ee9 (2026-10-06) then passed every other TP4 C64 gate with BF16 KV: teacher, preemption bit identity and burst, spec_verify, GSM8K 194/200, a 600-second soak and prefix equality. Speculation has workload-specific throughput regressions: at C64 with 64-token outputs, DFlash was slower than AR on chat and GSM8K.
